consequence.statement: Custom setups leveraging the removed `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label stop working once the label is gone from pods and external listener Services and must be changed to use `strimzi.io/pod-name` instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any custom setup that leverages the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label to use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from the pods it manages and from external listeners' Kubernetes Services; any custom setup leveraging that label must be changed to use the `strimzi.io/pod-name` label instead.
